question: For the top-consuming KAM customer in 2013, what was their average price per item across all transactions, and what currency did they use?

prediction.sql:
WITH top_customer AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
  FROM customers AS c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
  WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'
    AND y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY c.XCL_001
  ORDER BY SUM(y.XCL_021) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  AVG(t.XCL_018 / t.XCL_017) AS average_price_per_item,
  c.XCL_003 AS currency
FROM customers AS c
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
INNER JOIN top_customer AS tc ON c.XCL_001 = tc.customer_id

  c.XCL_003 AS currency
FROM customers AS c
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
INNER JOIN top_customer AS tc ON c.XCL_001 = tc.customer_id
